parameters.name: DeleteAfterImageUpload
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable automatic release of the instance after the image is packaged and uploaded. This parameter is supported only for build instances.

- true: The image is released together with the instance when the instance is released.
- false: The image is retained when the instance is released.
- If this parameter is left empty, the default value is false.

parameters.name: ImageName
parameters.description: The image name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter but cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: TargetOSSRegionId
parameters.description: The region of the destination OSS bucket where the image is stored.

parameters.name: WithDataDisks
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include data cloud disks when creating the image.
